answer_1.quote: Natural Language Transformation (NLT) refers to the process of rewriting or adapting natural language texts at semantic, structural, or stylistic levels to fulfill specific task requirements or achieve desired functionalities. It encompasses a variety of tasks, including machine translation and text style transfer...

answer_2.quote: Our evaluation metrics include both statistical and neural metrics, but we place a primary emphasis on neural metrics, using statistical metrics only as a reference with a limited level of confidence. For neural metrics, we adopted the XCOMET series models, and for statistical metrics, we used BLEU.

answer_3.quote: For this evaluation task, we adopted the LLM-as-Judge method as the main evaluation metric, leveraging the capabilities of large language models to assess the quality, fluency, and stylistic consistency of the generated text.
